profile.name: 惠普 6632B 系统直流电源
profile.description: HP 6632B 是一台可编程系统直流电源，输出范围约为 0–20 V、0–5 A，具备精密低电流测量和低输出噪声特性。它常用于为实验样品或电子电路稳定供电，并在自动化测试中执行受触发的电压、电流和保护相关测试。
profile.description_en: The HP 6632B is a programmable system DC power supply rated for about 0–20 V and 0–5 A, with precision low-current measurement and low output noise. It is commonly used to provide stable power to devices or circuits under test and to perform triggered voltage, current, and protection-related tests in automated lab setups.

registry.name: Hewlett-Packard Hp6632b
registry.description: Hewlett-Packard Hp6632b是由Hewlett-Packard (Keysight)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、触发。支持Signal, Slot, check error queue等操作。
